name: Read-only signer inspection mode
scope: Show verified non-signer group members the same signer layout for support and position guidance
Disable all counterparty, identity-upload, signature, consent, and submission controls in inspection mode
Preserve the designated-signer-only server authorization and evidence boundary

dataIsolation.guard: Inspection exposes only the already-authorized contract signing layout; it does not expose another browser's local entries or grant evidence-write authority.

definitionOfDone: A verified non-signer group member sees the full signer layout with a clear read-only inspection banner
All form, upload, signature, consent, and submission controls are disabled for the inspector
The signature location is visibly identified inside the large signature box
A non-signer submit request is rejected before evidence storage
Inspection does not change contract status or create signer first-open evidence
